title: A $q$-Caputo Fractional Generalization of Tsallis Entropy
summary: In this work we build a $q$-Caputo fractional generalization of the Tsallis entropy functional $S_q$. The construction starts from the already known Jackson derivative representation of $S_q$ and replaces the Jackson derivative with a Caputo type $q$-fractional operator ${}^{C}D_q^α$. The parameter $q$ keeps its standard role as the nonextensive index, while the fractional parameter $α$ gives a nonlocal, memory like contribution in the entropy generating procedure.
